technique_name: Compare and contrast the regularization methods of L1 and L2.
description: L1 regularization, also known as Lasso regularization, is a type of regularization technique used to minimize the number of parameters in a particular model by adding a penalty term known as the L1 norm. This norm penalizes the coefficients of parameters that are farther away from zero. The regularization coefficient is directly proportional to the magnitude of the coefficent.
